Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.value: paint a 2BHK flat in Indirapuram; both bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and balcony grill
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.quote: Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Poora flat paint karwana hai - dono bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur balcony ki grill bhi.

Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.text: Ramesh asks whether the ceiling should also be painted or only the walls.
Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.quote: Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya sirf walls?

Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.text: The hirer says the job also includes the ceiling and putty in one bedroom where there is dampness.
Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.quote: Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi seelan hai, wahan putty bhi lagegi.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Paint kaunsa lagwana hai, normal emulsion ya premium wala?

Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.text: Sunita says the whole house was done for 20,000 last time.
Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.quote: Pichhli baar 20 mein poora ghar hua tha.

24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.text: Sunita says the work should be done well.
24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.quote: 24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahiye.

Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.quote: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.quote: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?.text: The hirer accepts the 24,000 rupees total.

Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.quote: Material lana padega na madam, to 8 hazaar advance de dijiye, kaam shuru karne se pehle.

Ji bilkul, chalega..text: The worker accepts the 8,000 rupees advance said just before.

Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle h.quote: Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle hafte mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain.

Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..text: The worker says the job will start this Monday.
Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..quote: Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon.

Aur khatam kab tak hoga?.text: Sunita asks when the work will be finished.

Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.text: The worker says the work will start Monday and finish Friday evening.
Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.quote: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jay.quote: Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jayenge, uske baad nahi chalega.

Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.text: Sunita accepts the 500 rupees per day delay cut.
Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.quote: Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakhna.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.text: Sunita says to come on Monday at 9 in the morning.
Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.text: The hirer says they will meet on Monday.
Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.quote: Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko milte hain. Bye.
